🚨 Traffic Advisory – Shri Krishna Janmashtami 🚨

A fair will be held at Prem Mandir, Railway Road, Gurugram on 16.08.2025, from 5:00 PM onwards.

🔁 Traffic Diversions:

1️⃣ From 4/7 Chowk to Sohna Chowk
➡️ Divert via New Colony Mod → Pataudi Road

2️⃣ From Sohna Chowk/Shiv Murti Chowk to Railway Road
➡️ Take left from Shiv Murti → via Lady Fatima School → New Colony Mod → Railway Road

📌 Commuter Tips:
✅ Follow traffic signs and police instructions
✅ Plan travel in advance
✅ Expect delays near Prem Mandir

🌼 Wishing you a blessed and joyful Janmashtami!

#TrafficAdvisory #Janmashtami #Gurugram #Traffic #Police
